environment.description: ECS Fargate task in private subnet with NAT gateway for S3 access. Task role has s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::* to support multi-tenant routing. CLI processes manifests from partner SFTP drop zone mounted via EFS. No VPC endpoint configured - traffic routes through NAT to public S3 endpoints.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, no VPC endpoints
config.s3_access: Via NAT gateway to public S3 endpoint
